description: Passes on master and must keep passing: the brand name still finds the brand row with all its POIs, bank branches included (the filter of a brand row does not check the POI type), and the plain atm category lists ATMs only. The extract belarus_minsk_brands is cut out of Belarus_minsk_europe_2.obf: the 8 POIs nearest to Minsk of each value of brand / brand:xx of Belarusbank and Lukoil, up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative), and the 6 nearest plain atm, bank and fuel POIs.
